verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AML and KYC compliance platform, so duplicate-identity detection is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, monitoring and case management. Nothing shows face or document matching across verifications or automatic flagging of identities that resurface under different names. The unique external_identifier requirement is an adjacent data-integrity control, not duplicate-identity detection, so it earns no credit.
